what_it_is: Custom park: CYD, my latest THPS2 skatepark. (Yes, I still play THPS2 in 2007.) CYD has, shall we say, a "surprise" when you begin.
format: DexDrive .gme: '123-456-STD' 3904-byte header (per-block comments) + 131072-byte raw card; the card holds 1 save(s), 1 for this game (BASLUS-01066SQZSPCP)
